address: Quay Steps, St Peter Port, GY1 2LE, United Kingdom
bio: A stalwart of the Guernsey restaurant scene, Le Nautique continues to delight diners and be the name on everyone’s lips around the island. It’s easy to see why, for this is a restaurant run with heart and pride that serves straightforward, satisfying fare that’s perfect for the setting. Occupying a former sailmaker’s warehouse on the quayside (ask for an upstairs window seat for the best views) and sporting a stylish nautical design, this is a place to relish seafood of all shapes and sizes. Clean, classical dishes show off the prime produce with minimal adornment.
